content.text: I need to find the top 10 teams with the most wins. First, I will find all the teams and their wins in home and away games. Then, I will combine these wins and rank the teams to get the top 10.

args.sql:
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name,
    count(*) as total_wins
FROM wins w
JOIN Team t ON w.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10
